profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory founded in 2020 and operating as the applied research arm of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). It describes itself as a leading global scientific research center, and its primary public-facing work centers on the development and open-source release of large language models under the Falcon brand, available under the Apache 2.0 license.

The institute's Falcon model family spans a range of architectures and scales. Falcon 40B, trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, was the first model released with weights for both research and commercial use. Falcon 180B, trained on 180 billion parameters and 3.5 trillion tokens, has appeared at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained open large language models. Falcon 2 11B is described as outperforming Meta's Llama 3 8B and performing on par with Google's Gemma 7B model, as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard, and adds multimodal vision-to-language capabilities. Falcon-H1 uses a hybrid architecture combining Transformer and Mamba designs and is described as outperforming Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen. Additional models include Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open-source State Space Language Model, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, Falcon Perception for vision-and-language tasks, and Falcon H1R 7B focused on reasoning in mathematics, coding, and logic.

TII has also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit entity dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models and building ecosystems around open-source projects. A separate entity, AI71, launched by ATRC and VentureOne, has organized a call for proposals and a hackathon around Falcon 10B, offering compute access to selected developers. The held facts confirm TII is a non-profit government laboratory with Middle East data residency positioning and no recorded litigation.
